limits: eth_call does not broadcast and does not prove UI rejection handling.
All responses are from the stated endpoint, not local Ganache. Chain ID alone does not independently authenticate canonical network history.
Gas fields are preserved as RPC observations; no inference that Ethereum protocol gas rules changed.
This script is Codex-assisted reproduction, not approval by another group member.
